name: İyileşme Kanalı
purpose: A research-based awareness platform focused on the holistic healing of body, mind, and consciousness, built around four pillars: balance, consciousness, biology, and transformation (tagline: Denge - Bilinc - Donusum). Covers nervous-system science, longevity, and lasting personal transformation with an academic, calm, and sophisticated voice.
audience: People interested in holistic wellbeing and functional health -- nervous-system science, longevity, and personal transformation -- who are drawn to research-grounded, non-clinical content about healing and biology rather than clinical or medical-treatment advice.
